title: Somna: sleep diary & CBT-I program for Android
description: Somna is a 6-week CBT-I program for insomnia: a daily sleep diary, weekly personalized sleep windows, 42-day sleep efficiency trends, and an AI sleep coach. Free on Google Play.
og_title: Somna: retrain your sleep with clinical CBT-I
og_description: A 6-week cognitive behavioral therapy program for insomnia. Sleep diary, weekly sleep windows, and evidence-based consolidation. Free on Google Play.
ld_description: Sleep diary and 6-week CBT-I program for chronic insomnia with sleep restriction, stimulus control, and an AI sleep coach.
h1: Retrain your sleep with clinical CBT-I.
lede: Somna combines a daily sleep diary with a structured 6-week program based on cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia. Rebuild your sleep drive, shrink hours spent awake in bed, and let science consolidate your nights.
free_note: Free. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
insomnia_diagnosis: In bed 8h 30m, but awake for 2h 15m. Sleep efficiency is 74%.
insomnia_prescription: CBT-I Sleep Restriction: Spending too much awake time in bed weakens your sleep drive. Restrict sleep window to 7h 00m (delay bedtime to 00:00). Leave bed if awake for 20 minutes.
broken_diagnosis: In bed 8h 30m with 2 hours of fragmented night awakenings. Sleep efficiency is 71%.
broken_prescription: Stimulus Control Protocol: If awake for more than 20 minutes, leave the bed. Only return when drowsy. Strictly preserve the association between bed and sleep.
week4_diagnosis: In bed 7h 15m, actual sleep 6h 40m. Sleep efficiency reached 92%.
week4_prescription: Sleep drive consolidated! Bed is now strongly associated with restorative sleep. Maintain current sleep window or expand bedtime by 15 minutes.
console_note: Simulated using Somna's weekly sleep restriction formula. Pick a preset or adjust scenarios to explore CBT-I feedback.
screens_title: Clinical CBT-I, designed for your nightstand.
screens_sub: Everything you need to reset your sleep cycle without sleeping pills.

program_title: A structured 6-week journey to natural sleep.
program_sub: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) is the gold standard, first-line treatment recommended by clinical sleep medicine.
w1_desc: Log bedtimes, wake times, and night awakenings. Discover your true baseline sleep efficiency without judgment or pressure.
w2_desc: Temporarily match your time in bed to your actual sleep duration. Rebuild intense, natural homeostatic sleep pressure.
w3_desc: Break the subconscious link between your bed and frustration or wakefulness. The strict 20-minute rule: if awake, get out of bed.
w4_desc: Dismantle catastrophic sleep anxiety ('If I don't sleep 8 hours, tomorrow is ruined') using clinically proven cognitive reframing.
w5_desc: Anchor your morning wake-up time, synchronize sunlight exposure, calibrate bedroom temperature, and set caffeine cutoffs.
w6_desc: Lock in lifelong healthy sleep habits. Review your transformation report, sign your graduation pledge, and keep your certificate.
tools_title: Wind down before your sleep window.
tools_sub: Calm your sympathetic nervous system with soothing acoustic soundscapes and guided 4-7-8 breathing.
breathe_desc: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 7s, exhale 8s slowly through the mouth. Stimulates the vagus nerve and lowers heart rate.
sound_desc: White noise, pink noise, brown noise, gentle rain, and ocean waves. Synthesized to mask distracting noises and cradle you into sleep.
sound_hint: Tap any soundscape to preview real synthesized ambient sound right in your browser.
coach_title: An AI sleep coach that reads your diary.
coach_sub: Trained on clinical CBT-I guidelines. Analyzes your past 14 nights of logs to deliver empathetic, personalized feedback anytime.
coach_user_msg: My sleep efficiency reached 87% this week, but I still feel sleepy at 22:00. Should I go to bed earlier?
coach_ai_msg: Congratulations on hitting 87% efficiency! That shows your sleep consolidation is working. However, stick to your prescribed 23:15 window for at least two more days. Going to bed too early risks fragmenting your sleep again. If you feel tired, try 10 minutes of gentle stretching or reading under dim light first.
honest_title: Grounded in sleep science, not gimmicks.
nots: No sleeping pills, melatonin candies, or chemical dependencies.
No magical promises like 'fall asleep in 10 seconds without effort'.
No forced user accounts or dark patterns.
No health data harvesting. Your sleep diary stays strictly private on your phone.
honest_body: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) is recommended by the American College of Physicians (ACP) and European Sleep Research Society as the #1 initial treatment for chronic insomnia, outperforming sleeping medication in long-term efficacy.
pro_title: Sleep diary and baseline tools are free.
pro_body: Somna Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks the complete 6-week guided CBT-I curriculum, automatic weekly sleep window adjustments, full 42-day trend insights, AI sleep coach analysis, and all soundscapes. No monthly fees ever.
